question.text: Which of the following is TRUE about enhanced indexing (smart beta) vs pure indexing?

answer.text: Enhanced indexing allows ongoing manager discretion daily
Smart beta has no tracking error
Smart beta uses rule-based, factor-tilted construction — higher tracking error than pure index, lower fees than active
Pure indexing has higher fees than smart beta

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Smart beta: rule-based with factor tilts → non-trivial tracking error vs cap-weighted, but fees are lower than discretionary active. **The Trap:** 'No tracking error' is false; daily discretion would make it active, not smart beta. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-A covers this at product level; X-A at adviser level. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Factor timing (deciding when to tilt to value vs momentum) is where smart beta quietly becomes active — question any product that rotates factors frequently.
